profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.geoLocationName: Salt Lake City, Utah, United States
profile.summary: I have ten years of professional brewing experience leading departments towards production goals, developing new products, creating and implementing SOPs, and continuously improving process methods.

positions.title: Director of Inventory and Scheduling
positions.locationName: Salt Lake City, Utah, United States

positions.title: Master Scheduler
positions.description:
- Led daily stand up meetings with multiple departments to align production goals
- Led end of month finished goods inventory
- Managed inventory of product with average shelf life of four months
- Worked with contract brewing partners to ensure deadlines for production orders are met
- Created a rolling three month production schedule through ERP software for each department based on sales forecasts to optimize inventory levels
- Communicated effectively with brewing, packaging, quality, and maintenance departments to ensure
 goals are met
- Assisted departments with solutions to production issues

positions.title: Head Brewer
positions.description:
- Oversaw all day to day operations while managing pub brewers on 2 vessel, 10 bbl and 15 bbl 
    direct fire brewhouses
- Managed inventory levels and created weekly production schedules for multiple locations
- Implemented EKOs brewery management software and maintained accuracy of software
- Created SOPs for all processes in production and laboratory 
- Developed all new beer recipes
- Continuous process improvement mindset
- Led bottling operations on an HDP 4 head filler
- Transitioned packaged brands to  bottle conditioned to maximize yields and improve quality
- Educated pub servers on new beers and styles
- Created beer education courses for pub servers
- Designed and oversaw the installation of a new 15 bbl brewpub in Lehi, UT

positions.title: QA/R&D Manager
positions.description:
- Developed new products for company
- Scaled recipes from 1 bbl test batches to 40 bbl and/or 130 bbl production batches
- Research and implement new production processes to achieve target flavor profiles
- Improved process efficiencies to achieve production and quality goals
- Implemented and maintained a quality management system
- Managed a team of three (quality intern, quality technician, and microbiologist)
- Created Quality Technician proficiency levels 
- Created weekly KPI reports for brewhouse and cellar
- Contributed to the development of a food safety plan
- Member of the New Product Development Team
- Created and implemented updated microbiological testing of green beer prior to filtration
- Created and implemented laboratory SOPs and training logs

positions.title: Brewing Supervisor
positions.description:
- Managed day-to-day brewery operations and led the brewing department for seven months until a Brewmaster was hired
- Addressed problems with production and implemented improved SOPs
- Created SOPs for full operation of a Braukon 130 bbl brewhouse and a Master Sanitation Schedule for the cellar
- Managed a team of eight brewers and cellar operators
- Created Brewer proficiency levels for career advancement of Brewers
- Coordinated with scheduling to create the most efficient brewing and cellar schedule
- Conducted the hiring process for brewers and yearly performance reviews
- Oversaw all physical and digital record keeping and trained Brewers on Orchestrated Beer
- Managed all fermentations (35 FVs)
- Responsible for yeast management of four different yeast strains, including Brettanyomyces

positions.title: Brewer
positions.description: Responsible for wort production on a Braukon 130 bbl brewhouse, CIP of brewhouse vessels, troubleshoot problems as they arise, train new employees in the brewhouse, and communicate effectively with other brewers to foster a team atmosphere.
